title: Lower-Bounded Hamiltonians for Many-Body Point Interactions
exact_target: Construct mathematically sound many-particle contact-interaction Hamiltonians that do not collapse to arbitrarily negative energy.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath, record 30003581 (OWR-15584-001). Catalogue curation under CC BY 4.0; definitions and English exposition added locally.

Mathematical Questions and Challenges in Quantum Electrodynamics and its Applications (2017), Oberwolfach Reports, DOI 10.4171/owr/2017/41, pp. 2539--2599. Primary report accessed 2026-10-11; relevant PDF pages 40.
Three-body zero-range interactions (catalogue-listed context; not independently consulted in this preparation).
Contact-interaction Hamiltonians (catalogue-listed context; not independently consulted in this preparation).

status_qualification: The report explains that unrestricted bosonic zero-range systems can suffer Thomas collapse and focuses on a fermion-plus-distinguishable-particle model. Thus this extraction is a construction question in admissible regimes, not an existence claim for every statistics or mass ratio.
